request.text: Tomorrow at 7:30 AM, remind me to put the signed permission slip in Ava's backpack before school.

responsibilities.outcome: Create a one-time reminder for 7:30 AM tomorrow to put the signed permission slip in Ava's backpack before school.

new_goals.description: Be reminded to put Ava's signed permission slip in her backpack before school.
new_goals.source_text: Tomorrow at 7:30 AM, remind me to put the signed permission slip in Ava's backpack before school.

semantic_facts: The requested durable one-time reminder requires chromie.reminder.create, which the catalog override explicitly marks unavailable.
The planner must fail closed without emitting executable work and may report unavailability, escalate, or ask a capability-resolving clarification without claiming success.

Weather lookup or any embodied action can substitute for reminder creation.
